idea-plugin.name: SecretBridge for 1Password
idea-plugin.description:
Zero-trust 1Password secret orchestration for JetBrains IDEs, backed by an isolated Linux microVM Rust enclave over AF_VSOCK and Noise_IK transport encryption.
  • Browse 1Password Service Account vault, item, and field metadata without exposing plaintext values to the JVM heap.
  • Generate secrets via in-enclave CSPRNG or capture external secrets with a 15-second single-shot Armed Copy Hijack.
  • Preview and apply cryptographically signed sync plans between 1Password, AWS Secrets Manager, and GitHub Actions.
  • Render deterministic .env, GitHub Actions workflow, Terraform, AWS CDK, and CloudFormation secret reference templates.
